svg.title: MDviewer: Markdown to PDF with nothing sliced at a page break (animated)
svg.desc: Animated loop: typing in the source pane grows a code block near the bottom of page 1. A naive converter would slice it across the break, but MDviewer moves the whole block to page 2. A long table splits cleanly with its header repeated, and the same paginated layout feeds Print or Save as PDF as the primary vector export, with a raster Download PDF fallback.
svg.text: runs in your browser · documents never uploaded · paginate once with Paged.js · two export paths

g.text: block kept whole: moved to page 2

svg.text: Type in the source pane and the preview repaginates as you go
A naive converter would slice the code block at the page break
MDviewer keeps it whole and moves it to page 2
A table taller than the space splits cleanly, with its header repeated
Paginate once, then export: vector print is primary, raster download is the fallback
